Description: Client-only role enforcement; easily bypassed via React DevTools
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open DevTools. 2. Select AuthProvider in React tree. 3. Change role to OWNER. 4. Open Settings tab
Expected Behavior: Restricted tabs should be blocked by server-side authorization session
Actual Behavior: Settings tab opens and allows full owner administrative access
Root Cause: Role state is stored in client React state without server session validation
Recommended Correction: Implement server-side session cookies (Auth.js) and Next.js middleware

Description: Hardcoded master PIN 1234 across all staff accounts
Reproduction Steps: 1. Click Fast Role Switcher. 2. Switch to Owner Harshit Raj. 3. Enter PIN 1234
Expected Behavior: Each staff member must have a unique salted & hashed PIN/password
Actual Behavior: Owner account unlocks with common PIN 1234
Root Cause: Hardcoded plaintext PIN in DEMO_USERS array
Recommended Correction: Store hashed passwords in database; implement individual PIN reset

Description: Checkout does not post journal entries to Accounts cashbook/bank
Reproduction Steps: 1. Finalize retail bill of ₹150000 in Cash. 2. Navigate to Accounts tab. 3. Inspect Account 1010
Expected Behavior: Cash drawer account 1010 balance should increment by ₹150000
Actual Behavior: Account 1010 balance remains unchanged at seeded ₹50000
Root Cause: handleFinalizeBill does not call recordJournalEntry or update Account balances
Recommended Correction: Add automatic double-entry journal posting inside handleFinalizeBill

Description: Stock locking name-fallback bug marks multiple unsold items sold
Reproduction Steps: 1. Seed 2 identical rings with name 'Gold Ring' but different barcodes. 2. Bill 1 ring by name without barcode
Expected Behavior: Only the single invoiced ring should transition to sold
Actual Behavior: Both rings transition to sold status in inventory
Root Cause: lineItems.some matches by name without consuming or checking unique item ID
Recommended Correction: Require unique stockItemId/SKU or consume matched item so it cannot match again

Description: Wholesale purchases do not update supplier payables liability account
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inward ₹300000 purchase on credit. 2. Inspect Account 2010 (Supplier Payables)
Expected Behavior: Account 2010 should increase by ₹300000
Actual Behavior: Account 2010 remains unchanged
Root Cause: handleRecordPurchase updates supplier store but not accounts store
Recommended Correction: Dispatch journal entry debiting Inventory Asset and crediting Account 2010

Description: Memo conversion to invoice does not write into central Invoices Registry
Reproduction Steps: 1. Create consignment memo. 2. Convert item to invoice WH-INV-101. 3. Open Invoices Registry
Expected Behavior: WH-INV-101 should appear in Invoices list and GSTR-1 reports
Actual Behavior: WH-INV-101 only exists inside memo store; absent from Invoices Registry
Root Cause: convertMemoToInvoice updates memo item but does not call saveNewInvoice
Recommended Correction: Wire convertMemoToInvoice to create a FinalizedInvoice in central store

Description: Pure bullion issue to artisan does not deduct bullion from central stock
Reproduction Steps: 1. Check central bullion inventory. 2. Issue 100g 24K bar to karigar. 3. Re-check inventory
Expected Behavior: Central 24K bullion inventory should decrease by 100g
Actual Behavior: Central bullion stock is unchanged; only karigar ledger increments
Root Cause: handleIssueMetalToKarigar does not deduct from StockItem or Account 1040
Recommended Correction: Add central stock deduction and stock movement record when issuing pure bullion

Description: Receiving finished jewellery from karigar does not inward new stock item
Reproduction Steps: 1. Receive finished necklace from karigar in Karigar tab. 2. Open Inventory tab
Expected Behavior: Finished necklace should appear in showcase inventory with barcode
Actual Behavior: Inventory tab does not contain the new necklace
Root Cause: receiveOrnamentFromKarigar does not create a StockItem in inventory store
Recommended Correction: Add automated or 1-click 'Inward to Showcase' button upon receiving ornament

Description: Girvi loan disbursements & interest payments do not update cash drawer
Reproduction Steps: 1. Disburse ₹150000 pawn loan in Cash. 2. Inspect Account 1010 (Cash Drawer)
Expected Behavior: Account 1010 balance should decrease by ₹150000
Actual Behavior: Account 1010 balance is unchanged
Root Cause: createGirviLoan and payGirviInterest are isolated from accounts store
Recommended Correction: Connect Girvi loan disbursement and interest vouchers to Account 1010/1020

Description: Multi-store writes lack ACID rollback on client failure
Reproduction Steps: 1. Trigger billing checkout. 2. Simulate browser crash/quota error before invoice write
Expected Behavior: Transaction should completely roll back to prevent half-saved states
Actual Behavior: Stock is marked sold but invoice and customer records are missing
Root Cause: Sequential independent localStorage calls without rollback mechanism
Recommended Correction: Wrap operational mutations in server-side Prisma atomic transaction ($transaction)

Description: Customer PAN Aadhaar and wholesale purchase costs stored in plaintext localStorage
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open DevTools -> Application -> Local Storage. 2. Inspect jewellery_os_tenant_*_customers
Expected Behavior: Sensitive identity and cost records should be encrypted and server-protected
Actual Behavior: Plaintext JSON displays PAN numbers addresses and wholesale costs
Root Cause: Direct serialization of unencrypted domain models to browser storage
Recommended Correction: Migrate sensitive records to encrypted PostgreSQL with server-side authorization

Description: Prisma businessId expects UUID while client uses string tenant IDs
Reproduction Steps: 1. Attempt querying Prisma Business model with ID 'tenant-sandhya-jaipur'
Expected Behavior: Database query should execute seamlessly with tenant string identifier
Actual Behavior: Prisma client throws validation error: Invalid UUID string format
Root Cause: Prisma schema specifies @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
Recommended Correction: Change businessId and ID fields to String @id @default(cuid()) or text identifiers

Description: Prisma schema missing models for 7 operational modules
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect prisma/schema.prisma for Memos Repairs Staff or Closings
Expected Behavior: Schema should contain relational models for all 14 implemented modules
Actual Behavior: Models for Memos Repairs JobCards Purchases Expenses Staff Settings are absent
Root Cause: Schema was created in early milestone and never updated for later modules
Recommended Correction: Add Prisma models for ConsignmentMemo RepairJob JobCard PurchaseInvoice DailyCashClosing StaffMember ShowroomMasterSettings

Description: Rate history uses global storage key leaking notes across tenants
Reproduction Steps: 1. Switch to Tenant A; add rate note. 2. Switch to Tenant B; inspect rate history
Expected Behavior: Tenant B should only see Tenant B's rate history and notes
Actual Behavior: Tenant B sees Tenant A's internal rate fixations and notes
Root Cause: RATES_HISTORY_STORAGE_KEY is static without tenantId scoping
Recommended Correction: Parameterize storage key with tenantId: jewellery_os_tenant_${tenantId}_rates_history

Description: Zero Next.js API routes or Server Actions in repository
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect src/app directory for api/ folder or 'use server' directives
Expected Behavior: Backend endpoints should process business logic and validate permissions
Actual Behavior: All 14 modules run purely in client browser state
Root Cause: Prototype built with client stores without backend server routes
Recommended Correction: Create Next.js Route Handlers (/api/*) and Server Actions for all mutations

Description: Synchronous setState in useEffect in AuthContext triggers cascading renders
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run npm run lint
Expected Behavior: Linter should pass with 0 errors
Actual Behavior: ESLint error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect
Root Cause: Direct setIsMounted(true) inside useEffect body
Recommended Correction: Initialize state directly or use non-cascading synchronization

Description: ESLint reports 31 errors and 245 warnings across codebase
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run npm run lint in terminal
Expected Behavior: Linter passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
Actual Behavior: 276 problems (31 errors 245 warnings) reported
Root Cause: Unused variables explicit any typing and unmemoized callbacks
Recommended Correction: Clean up unused imports and replace loose any types with strict domain interfaces

Description: Missing physical stock audit count reconciliation workflow
Reproduction Steps: 1. Search for stock audit or physical discrepancy reconciler in UI
Expected Behavior: Showroom inventory should support scanning shelves and flagging missing pieces
Actual Behavior: Feature is absent; operator can only manually toggle status to damaged/missing
Root Cause: Feature was planned but never implemented in UI or store
Recommended Correction: Build StockAuditModal allowing scanning tray barcodes and reconciling discrepancies

Description: Missing sales return and credit note generation workflow
Reproduction Steps: 1. Search for return invoice or credit note in Billing workspace
Expected Behavior: Cashier should be able to look up past bill and process item return with refund
Actual Behavior: Feature is absent; cashier must manually edit records or adjust ledger
Root Cause: Feature was planned but not yet built into POS UI
Recommended Correction: Implement SalesReturnModal with restock destination (Showcase vs Repair) and Credit Note

Description: npm audit reports 13 vulnerabilities including 1 critical in Next.js
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run npm audit
Expected Behavior: Dependencies report 0 vulnerabilities
Actual Behavior: 1 critical (Next.js 16.3.6) 5 high and 7 moderate vulnerabilities reported
Root Cause: Outdated next@16.3.6 and @prisma/config dependencies
Recommended Correction: Upgrade Next.js to 16.4.6 or later and update Prisma toolchain

Description: localStorage quota limit (5MB) risks catastrophic failure at scale
Reproduction Steps: 1. Accumulate 5000 invoices with serialized item histories in browser
Expected Behavior: Storage should seamlessly scale to hundreds of thousands of records
Actual Behavior: Browser throws QuotaExceededError and aborts saving invoices
Root Cause: Browser localStorage is strictly capped at 5MB-10MB per origin
Recommended Correction: Migrate storage from localStorage to PostgreSQL / IndexedDB

Description: Missing direct JSON export for Government GST Offline Utility
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Reports -> GST Compliance. 2. Search for GST Offline Tool Export
Expected Behavior: One-click button should export GSTR-1 HSN 7113 JSON for GST Portal upload
Actual Behavior: Reports only provide on-screen table and print pack
Root Cause: GST Offline JSON schema formatter not yet implemented
Recommended Correction: Add exportToGstr1Json utility generating GST Portal compliant schema

Description: Automated cloud backup sync (S3/Drive) is missing
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Settings -> Data Vault. 2. Search for automated backup schedule
Expected Behavior: System should automatically sync nightly JSON snapshots to private cloud storage
Actual Behavior: Only manual 1-click download button exists
Root Cause: Cloud storage SDK integration not implemented in client-only architecture
Recommended Correction: Add S3/Google Drive webhook hook in backend API

Description: Table horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports for wide ledger matrices
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open application on 375px mobile viewport. 2. Open Accounts or Reports
Expected Behavior: Tables should adapt with responsive cards or clean sticky headers
Actual Behavior: Wide data tables require horizontal swipe and text can wrap tightly
Root Cause: Desktop-first table layout in deep audit tabs
Recommended Correction: Add responsive card stack view for mobile viewports below 640px
